ENTITLED:“A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR AND CITY CLERK OF THE CITY
OF CHEYENNE TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT FOR THE TRADE OF REAL
PROPERTY OWNED BY THE CITY OF CHEYENNE, BEING A PARCEL OF LAND
LOCATED GENERALLY EAST OF MISSILE DRIVE AND SOUTH OF THE RIGHT-
OF-WAYOFWEST22NDSTREET, CHEYENNE, WYOMING, TO J IN AMOR AND IN

WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne is the owner of a parcel of land which is generally located
east of Missile Drive and south of the right-of-way of West 22"d Street, consisting of 6,098 square feet,
and having an appraised value of $6,098.00; and
WHEREAS, the City-owned parcel is proposed tobe traded for real property owned by Jina
Morandin Costello, Jeanie M.Grogan, K.Tippy Costello, and Kyle W.Breeden, generally located east
of Missile Drive and north ofthe right-of-way of West 22nd Street, consisting of43,560 square feet, and
having an appraised value of $43,560.00; and
WHEREAS, the parties wish to trade these interests as provided in Wyo.Stat.§15-1-112(b)(ii)
pursuant to the attached proposed Land Exchange Agreement between the parties; and
WHEREAS, the estimated appraised value of the property owned by the Cityis $6,098.00 and
the estimated appraised value of the property owned by Jina Morandin Costello, Jeanie M. Grogan, K.
Tippy Costello, and Kyle W.Breeden, is $43,560.00; and
WHEREAS, the Citywill pay additional cash consideration to J in a Mor and in Costello, Jeanie
M. Grogan, K.Tippy Costello, and Kyle W. Breeden to equalize the values of the interests to be traded
and to compensate said persons for the acquisition of certain permanent and temporary ease ment s needed
for the construction of storm water drainage improvements known generally as the “Snyder Storm
Sewer,”and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne does hereby determine that the parcel
of land owned by the Cityis no longer being used orneeded for any public purpose and that said land
may be traded to Jina Morandin Costello, Jeanie M. Grogan, K.Tippy Costello, and Kyle W.Breeden,
as partial consideration for the acquisition of the parcel of land owned by said persons and for the
acquisition of certain permanent and temporary easements as neededto facilitate the Snyder Storm Sewer
project; and
WHEREAS, notice ofthe proposed trade and of the public hearing regarding the proposed trade
have been advertised in a newspaper of general circulation in the manner required by Wyo. Stat. 15-1-
112; and
WHEREAS, the public hearing required by Wyo.Stat.15-1-112 was conducted on October14,
2013, prior to the final passage of this Resolution.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OFTHE CITY OF
CHEYENNE, WYOMING, that theabove-described parcel of land owned by the City is hereby declared
as surplus and that the Mayorand City Clerk are authorized to enter into an agreement, in a form which
is substantially similar to the form of the proposed Land Exchange Agreement attached to this
Resolution, to exchange the said City-owned parcel and to pay additional cash consideration to acquire
that certain parcel of land and those certain permanent and temporary easements from Jina Morandin
Costello, Jeanie M. Grogan, K.Tippy Costello, and Kyle W.Breeden as described in said proposed
agreement, and to execute allfurther and additional documents as necessaryto achieve the exchange of
said land as directed here in.

SECTION TWO.TITLE; TITLE INSURANCE; CLOSING: Conveyance of title to
Parcels A and B shall be by quitclaim deeds.The City shall pay the premium for a standard form
minimum value title insurance policy issued by a title insurance company authorized to dobusiness

Grogan s shall pay the premium for a standard form title insurance policy issued by a title insurance
company authorized to do business in the State of Wyoming to insure the Grogans’title to Parcel
B.Title to be conveyed, in each instance, shall be good and marketable, subject only to liens,
encumbrances, restrictions, easements and other burdens which are not objected to in writing within
twenty(20) days after the City's receipt ofa commitment for theissuance ofa title insurance policy
for Parcel Aor within twenty(20)days after the Grogans’receipt of a commitment for the issuance
of a title insurance policy for Parcel B.In the event any defectin title to Parcel Ais not cured by
the Grogans before closing, the City shall have the right, in its sole discretion, to cancel this
Agreement.In the event any defect in title to Parcel Bis not cured by the Citybefore closing, the
Grogans shall have theright, in their sole discretion, to cancel this Agreement.Closing shall occur
when Laramie County Abstract &Title Company, Cheyenne, Wyoming, is in a position to record
all documents required under this Agreement, to make all disbursements, and to issue the title
insurance policies provided for herein, but in no event later than twenty (20) days after the date of
this Agreement, unless extended in writing by mutual agreement of the parties.
